admission_reason: Current development evidence shows no added information over metadata and no single-request profiling payback. A new reviewed specification is required before admitting probes.
metadata_interpretation: Handset dense-input scenarios, not measured RSS, statistical bounds or safety guarantees. Includes total input bytes per worker and largest fact partition copies.
cutoff_provenance: Post-hoc development choice between observed Stage B quarter-sample groups; not calibrated and not independent validation.
quality_policy: Unknown/flagged probe evidence never enables a lower-cap override. Failed or pressured probes retain incurred cost and fall back to the metadata choice.

objective.interpretation: Lifecycle allocation proxy plus complete recorded wall time; sample-preparation resource consumption and controller/metadata overhead are unmeasured. Not currency or actual utilization.
